notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout (Shopify storefront, no WAF/geo-block; hit a transient Shopify bot-check (HTTP 429 'Verifying your connection...') mid-run under rapid sequential requests, resolved with exponential backoff retries -- no proxy/impersonation needed). Count verification: EVERY qty is an exact exhaustive count via /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250, paged until exhaustion and deduped by product id (RULE 1 compliant) -- collections.json 'products_count' field was NOT trusted per prior finding that Shopify products_count is unreliable/inflated. Site structure: mega-menu is organized by fixture type/style, not by room; no room-based lighting hierarchy exists on this site, so Rule 0's 'traverse every room node' does not apply here (checked nav text for room words, none found beyond 'Kids Wall Light'). Category tree built from the full header mega-menu (119 distinct /collections/ links dumped via nav crawl) plus 3 collections surfaced only via homepage 'View all' carousels (Customised Chandelier, Cob Track Light, Magnetic Track Lights) that are not in the header nav but are live, linked, real categories. Site also exposes ~499 total Shopify collections (many are narrow attribute/tag auto-collections e.g. '10mm Magnetic Track Lights', '20mm Magnetic Track Lights', per-wattage/per-finish variants) that are NOT part of the visible site navigation -- these were deliberately excluded as noise, not genuine browsable categories. Exclusions applied: entire Fans branch (Ceiling Fans, Floor/Wall/Table Fans, Exhaust Fans, Chandelier Fans) per explicit instruction; bulbs/bare light-source items (Led Lamps -- MR11/MR16/QR111 reflector bulb SKUs; Led Strip Lights -- bare flexible LED tape with no fixture housing); wiring/mounting hardware (Led Drivers; Linear Profile Lighting -- aluminium/silicon channel that houses a strip, not a fixture itself); UV-C Disinfection Tubes (germicidal sanitising tubes, not a decor lighting product -- functional health/sanitation appliance); all promotional/sale/gift roll-ups (Decorative Lights on Promotion, Decorative Lights Stock Clearance, Latest Decorative Lights, Gifting Lights, Led Promotional Items, Outdoor Promotional Items); all brand-listing collections (Philips Decorative Lights, Eliante Decorative Lights, Philips Led Lights, Philips Outdoor Lights, Eliante by Jainsons Lights, Philips, Ecolink, Ledvance, Syska, Panasonic, Orient, Corvi, Havells, Wipro, Jaquar); 'All Products' (shop-all). Rule 0 (product type beats label) gains: kept High Bay Lights, Emergency Lights, Showcase Lights and Led Batten in scope -- these are complete lighting fixtures (not bulbs/fans/wiring), so the literal per-company instruction (exclude only bulbs/fans/wiring) keeps them in even though they read as commercial/utility rather than decorative; kept Led Mirrors and Picture/Mirror Light in scope under the blanket mirror-inclusion rule even though Led Mirrors currently lists 0 live products (verified empty via both products.json and the rendered collection page, not an extraction failure); pulled the non-lighting 'Home Decor' collection (Retro-style figurines/show-pieces, JSPHILO brand) into scope as Decorative Accessories since this lighting specialist also stocks a small decor-accessory line. Duplicate-company determination: no duplicate suspected. Site footer identifies the seller as 'Jainsons Lights Pvt Ltd, Chandni Chowk' (Delhi) with an independent JustDial listing and its own Eliante/Autonix private-label lines -- a distinct, single-brand D2C storefront, not an alias of another company on the master list (no master list was available to this worker to cross-check directly).
